name: 6-acetylmorphine
summary: 6-Monoacetylmorphine (6-MAM, 6-acetylmorphine, or 6-AM) is an opioid and also one of three active metabolites of heroin (diacetylmorphine), the others being morphine and the much less active 3-monoacetylmorphine (3-MAM).

pharmacology.text: 6-MAM occurs as a metabolite of heroin. Once it has passed first-pass metabolism, 6-MAM is then metabolized into morphine or excreted in urine. Heroin is rapidly metabolized by esterase enzymes in the brain and has an extremely short half-life. It has also relatively weak affinity to μ-opioid receptors because the 3-hydroxy group, essential for effective binding to the receptor, is masked by the acetyl group.

uses.en: It is not used as a medicine. It matters mainly in forensic and drug testing, as a marker of heroin use.
uses.zh: 它不作為藥品使用，主要的意義在於法醫與藥物檢驗，作為使用海洛因的指標。
uses.zhHans: 它不作为药品使用，主要的意义在于法医与药物检验，作为使用海洛因的指针。

sideEffects.en: As a strong opioid it causes drowsiness, nausea, itching, constipation and pinpoint pupils, and it can slow or stop breathing. It is part of why heroin acts so quickly, and overdose can be fatal.
sideEffects.zh: 作為強效鴉片類藥物，它會引起嗜睡、噁心、皮膚癢、便秘與瞳孔縮小，並可能使呼吸變慢甚至停止。它是海洛因作用如此迅速的原因之一，過量可能致命。
sideEffects.zhHans: 作为强效鸦片类药物，它会引起嗜睡、恶心、皮肤痒、便秘与瞳孔缩小，并可能使呼吸变慢甚至停止。它是海洛因作用如此迅速的原因之一，过量可能致命。

fact.en: It is the compound heroin turns into first in the body, and because it is found in urine only after heroin use, it is the marker laboratories look for to tell heroin from morphine or codeine.
fact.zh: 它是海洛因在體內首先轉變成的化合物；由於只有在使用海洛因後才會出現在尿液中，實驗室便以它作為指標，用來區分海洛因與嗎啡或可待因。
fact.zhHans: 它是海洛因在体内首先转变成的化合物；由于只有在使用海洛因后才会出现在尿液中，实验室便以它作为指针，用来区分海洛因与吗啡或可待因。
